Hello current and future fan editors! A new year has started and another one bites the dust.

In this year, we have seen movie companies embrace the internet by releasing free movies on utube! This is good, not only for the movie consumer, but for the possibility that the movie companies embrace the growing fan editor pastime as well. I can only hope they figure out a good way for all involved for it is not going to go away. Not at all.

The term "fanedit" is fast becoming part of movie terminology and I can only hope it becomes just that. The amount of movies available on youtube with the word "fanedit" is steadily increasing because of demand. Demand from the consumer. Demand from people like you and me. This to me is great.

There are so many star wars edits, it is possible that Lucas may have gave us the medium to show the movie companies a new market, a fan editor market. Thanks to those movies, the ones where lucas himself took it upon him to change the originals, to go back on his own word, showed the public how subtle changes can ruin or improve the original movie.

Millions want to see other versions of a final product, and they are willing to pay. Well, at least willing to sit through some advertisements. lol.

This year shall bring out more fantastic fan edits and I hope, more ways for the fan editor to show off his/her work.

Some are just fantastic and need more exposure if not for the talent behind the changes, but for the exhilaration, the experience of hearing and seeing a story told in a new way, that brings out more of the fun of movie consumption.

My hat is tipped in you direction for the edits that are coming. The awesome ones yet to be released!

I myself have at least 8 more to be released with ones I have planned to work on.

Of course there will be more animated star trek with original tos score!

Plus 2 new complete star trek episodes never before seen! Might even put some commercials in just for fun. lol.

Fanedits FTW!

Here is to you and a great fan editing 2016 for all!
